content_of_post_to_answer: How can positive energy be felt?
answer: Positive energy is often less a force we receive and more a quality we notice when our mind stops fighting the moment. A calm person, a kind interaction, or a meaningful task can feel “positive” because it creates inner alignment, not because something magical was added. I explore this pattern more deeply on my profile, for anyone who wants to look closer. Positive energy is usually the absence of unnecessary resistance, not the presence of constant excitement.
